R1.description: A measurement run names the test classes that reach each snapshot key, without changing any decision or the counts

R2.description: The planner places a declared group of classes on one shard within a share bound, leaves the shard count (pinned and raised counts included, no shard empty), the exclusive atoms and the plan's shape unchanged, and an empty table gives today's plan

R3.description: The committed table is measured, guarded against stale, duplicate and out-of-matrix members, and shown to move the plan without moving its determinism

R4.description: The pages and item records state the mechanism, the bound, the measured counts and the local-versus-runner caveat
